fields.text: GRIMPACK pack tear: Seedance image-to-video from the pack art, two prompt variants. The winner becomes the drag-scrubbed rip in the pack modal (v12).

fields.prompt: Locked-off shot, camera perfectly still. This ornate black foil booster pack floats on a pure black background. From its already-torn top-right corner, the metallic foil slowly TEARS open across the top, pulled by an unseen force: the foil resists, crinkles and curls back with heavy, realistic foil physics and jagged bright silver torn edges, revealing a dark opening with a growing ember-orange glow leaking out from inside. The lower pack, the skull emblem and the lettering stay completely still and unchanged. Slow, heavy, unsettling, gothic. No hands, no people.

Locked-off shot, camera perfectly still. This ornate black foil booster pack floats on a pure black background. For a long moment almost nothing moves except a faint breathing glow at the torn top-right corner. Then the foil begins to stretch and whiten under strain, and tears — slowly, reluctantly — across the top in stages, crinkling and peeling with realistic metallic foil physics, jagged silver edges, an ember-orange glow pulsing from the widening dark opening like something inside is breathing. At the very end the torn top flap gives way completely and falls off. The lower pack, skull emblem and lettering stay completely still and unchanged. Heavy, dread-filled, gothic. No hands, no people.
